Bombay High Court

Ramesh Kumar vs The State Of Maharashtra on 12 March, 2023

Author: A. B. Judge

Bench: A. B. Judge, C. D. Judge

         IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
              CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
          CRIMINAL BAIL APPLICATION NO. 100 OF 2023
          WITH CRIMINAL BAIL APPLICATION NO. 101 OF 2023

The applicant was arrested on 1 January 2023 and charged under Sections 302 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code. Page 1/5

Whether the applicant is entitled to bail under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. when the trial has not commenced for over a year.

Reliance is placed on Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation and Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau Of Investigation, where the Supreme Court held that bail is the rule.

Article 21 of the Constitution guarantees personal liberty. See also this very case.

The application is allowed. The applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000.
